name: @qorpera/shell
description: Qorpera Base shell — the minimal desktop app every company controller is built on.

scripts.build: tsgo -p tsconfig.build.json && shx rm -rf dist/userland dist/assets && shx cp -r userland dist/userland && shx cp -r assets dist/assets && shx cp ../../node_modules/marked/lib/marked.umd.js dist/userland/marked.umd.js && shx cp src/preload.cjs dist/preload.cjs
